text:
Predicates:
Beethoven(x) ::: x is Beethoven.
MusicPiece(x) ::: x is a music piece.
Write(x, y) ::: x writes y.
Premiere(x, y) ::: x premieres y.
Orchestra(x) ::: x is an orchestra.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Conductor(x) ::: x is a conductor.
SymphonyNo9(y) ::: y is Symphony No. 9.
ViennaMusicSociety(y) ::: y is Vienna Music Society.
Premiere(y, x) ::: y premiers x.

Premises:
MusicPiece(SymphonyNo9) ::: Symphony No. 9 is a music piece.
∀x (Composes(x, y) → Music(x, y)) ::: Composers write music pieces.
Write(Beethoven, SymphonyNo9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
Premiere(ViennaMusicSociety, SymphonyNo9) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Orchestra(ViennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society is an orchestra.
Leads(Beethoven, ViennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads Vienna Music Society.
Orchestra(x) → ∃y (Conductor(y) ∧ Leads(y, x)) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.

Conclusion:
¬Conductor(Beethoven) ::: Beethoven is not a conductor.
